version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This QuickBooks skill has powerful accounting and automation capabilities, but they are disclosed, purpose-aligned, and paired with clear approval and least-privilege instructions.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses network access, managed OAuth, optional SDKs, and a raw HTTP fallback with a Maton API key only when the CLI is unavailable; these are proportionate for an API integration but require careful credential handling.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is limited to pinned Maton CLI/SDK package versions and no executable files are shipped in the artifact; the skill does not auto-install, auto-run, or fetch unreviewed remote payloads.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions repeatedly default to read/list operations, require explicit user approval for writes, connection creation, destructive actions, hosted functions, triggers, and persistent destinations, and warn that external API content is untrusted data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth credentials, hosted functions, triggers, and destinations can persist across sessions, but the artifact discloses this and instructs agents to obtain approval, use DENY_ALL network policy for functions by default, scope triggers, and delete unused resources.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill enables QuickBooks reads and writes for customers, vendors, invoices, payments, bills, accounts, reports, and batch requests; that is high-impact financial authority, but it directly matches the stated accounting-administration purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you need agent-assisted QuickBooks administration. Use a least-privileged QuickBooks connection, verify the Maton account and connection before each request, review every financial write or deletion carefully, and avoid persistent triggers or destinations unless you explicitly need ongoing automation and understand what data will flow.
